members.name: banking_routing
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific topic is the message about?

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: customer sees a card payment they did not make / do not recognise
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: customer sees a cash/ATM withdrawal they did not make
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: customer sees a direct debit they do not recognise or did not set up
criteria.compromised_card: card details may have been stolen/compromised, someone else used the card, suspicious activity
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: card was lost or stolen, need to freeze/block it, or found a lost card
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: phone with the app was lost, stolen or left somewhere
criteria.passcode_forgotten: forgot app passcode / cannot log in with passcode, reset passcode
criteria.pin_blocked: card PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts, unblock PIN
criteria.change_pin: change the PIN of a card the customer already uses (not receiving the PIN for a new card)
criteria.request_refund: wants a refund from a merchant / to get money back for a purchase
criteria.refund_not_showing_up: a merchant refund has not appeared in the account
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: same payment charged twice / duplicate charge
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash / less than requested
criteria.reverted_card_payment: a card payment the customer made was cancelled or reverted by the merchant or system unexpectedly (not the customer asking to cancel something)
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: an unexpected small extra amount or charge on the statement (e.g. an extra £1, paid more than the price) that the customer wants explained; not a known fee type
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: using Apple Pay or Google Pay
criteria.atm_support: which ATMs can be used, using the card at ATMs
criteria.card_about_to_expire: card expiring, replacing an expired card
criteria.card_arrival: ordered card has not arrived yet
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery takes, delivery date
criteria.card_linking: linking/adding a card to the app or account
criteria.get_physical_card: getting a physical card, or where/how to receive the PIN for a new card
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, choosing one
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: which cards/currencies are supported for top up or payment
criteria.pending_card_payment: card payment still pending / taking long to go through
criteria.topping_up_by_card: how to top up with a card
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: top up with cash or cheque
criteria.top_up_failed: top up failed / did not work
criteria.verify_top_up: verifying a top up / top-up verification code
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: balance not updated after a bank transfer
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: balance not updated after depositing cash or cheque
criteria.cancel_transfer: customer wants to cancel or reverse a money transfer they made, or sent a transfer to the wrong account
criteria.transfer_into_account: how to transfer money into my account
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: recipient has not received the transfer
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: customer was charged a fee for paying by card
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: charged a fee for cash withdrawal
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: charged a fee for a transfer
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: fee for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: wrong exchange rate on a card payment
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: wrong exchange rate on a cash withdrawal
criteria.country_support: which countries the service and cards are available in, customers living outside the UK
criteria.edit_personal_details: change name, address or other personal details
criteria.verify_my_identity: how to verify identity, documents needed
